about: Headings in an open marimo notebook, written with plain quotes: the agent renames one, adds one, and adds a cell that needs a new package (tabulate). The install changes the file's header under marimo, whose reload then pairs cells by similar code: with headings in a form the file doesn't keep, it gave them each other's code (L1 on Haiku, #431). Every heading must still show its own text. Tags: already_open, markdown, install, python.
